observations: Photo 0 shows a red and black upholstered sofa with a curved backrest and armrests, featuring a pink pillow and a dark patterned pillow.
Photo 1 shows the same sofa from a side angle, revealing its full form, with a pink pillow and a dark patterned pillow on the seat.
The sofa has a two-tone design: red upholstery on the seat and backrest, black on the armrests and base.
The material appears to be faux leather or vinyl, with visible stitching and a slight sheen.
The sofa is placed on a tiled floor, with dark curtains in the background.
Watermark 'DMW CHEF' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are overlaid on both photos.

claims.claim: Just buy and use... enjoyment plenty
claims.evidence: The claim is a general statement about enjoyment and cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: The sofa may have hidden damage, such as tears, stains, or wear not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A close-up shot of the upholstery, especially around the seams and edges, and a full view of the backrest and armrests.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential hidden damage, which may reduce value.

risks.risk: The sofa may not be in original condition or may have been repaired or refinished.
risks.proof: A shot showing the underside of the sofa and any internal components or repairs.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly modified or repaired, which may lower value.

risks.risk: The sofa may have structural issues, such as loose joints or wobbling legs.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the sofa being gently pushed or shaken to test stability.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially unstable, which may reduce value.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the upholstery, especially around seams and edges.
A full view of the backrest and armrests to check for damage or wear.
A photo or video showing the underside of the sofa and any internal components.
A video or photo showing the sofa being gently pushed or shaken to test stability.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
